verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents background automation in a narrow sense: connectors (Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub) auto-sync via real-time webhooks, and user profiles update automatically as users interact with the system, both running without manual invocation. However, this is data-ingestion automation, not a general-purpose autonomous task/automation framework (no scheduled jobs, triggers, or agentic workflows beyond memory sync are documented). Missing for 10: evidence of a broader automation/workflow engine, user-configurable triggers or scheduled autonomous tasks beyond connector sync, and independent confirmation that background sync runs reliably unattended.
